low_confidence_under_50.title: Low confidence
low_confidence_under_50.description: Match confidence is below 50 — assignment quality is poor

continuity_dispute.title: Continuity dispute
continuity_dispute.description: Multiple swimmers claimed the same continuity instructor; this swimmer lost the tiebreak

match_confidence_below_70.title: Confidence below review target
match_confidence_below_70.description: Match confidence is below 70 — assignment should be checked

compatibility_below_50.title: Low compatibility
compatibility_below_50.description: Compatibility score is below 50 — instructor may not be a good fit

forced_assignment.title: Only one legal option
forced_assignment.description: Only one legal instructor was available after applying all constraints

uneven_pair_fit.title: Uneven pair fit
uneven_pair_fit.description: The two swimmers in this pair have a large gap in individual compatibility scores

note_requested_assignment.title: Note-requested assignment
note_requested_assignment.description: This assignment was influenced by a prefer or always note request

continuity_overrides_adapted_capability.title: Adapted capability override
continuity_overrides_adapted_capability.description: Swimmer has continuity with a previous instructor who is not marked adapted-capable — continuity was preserved per client policy

manual_policy_review_required.title: Manual policy review required
manual_policy_review_required.description: Solver surfaced a continuity-over-qualification tradeoff that requires human confirmation

continuity_capacity_conflict.title: Continuity capacity conflict
continuity_capacity_conflict.description: Multiple swimmers claimed continuity with the same instructor but only one class slot was available

continuity_blocked_by_adult_capability.title: Adult capability blocked continuity
continuity_blocked_by_adult_capability.description: Swimmer is 18 or older and has a continuity instructor, but that instructor is not adult-capable — continuity was not preserved

continuity_blocked_by_baby_capability.title: Baby capability blocked continuity
continuity_blocked_by_baby_capability.description: Swimmer is under 2.5 years old and has a continuity instructor, but that instructor is not baby-capable — continuity was not preserved

continuity_blocked_by_adapted_capability.title: Adapted capability blocked continuity
continuity_blocked_by_adapted_capability.description: Swimmer requires adapted instruction and has a continuity instructor who is not adapted-capable — continuity was not preserved

continuity_pairing_conflict.title: Pairing continuity conflict
continuity_pairing_conflict.description: Pair lost continuity with their previous instructor because that instructor was assigned to a private continuity swimmer

non_response_swimmer_type.title: Default swimmer type used
non_response_swimmer_type.description: Swimmer has the Non-Response / Unknown type — survey data was not provided

default_instructor_profile.title: Default instructor profile used
default_instructor_profile.description: Instructor was missing color, style, or certification data, so the configured default instructor profile was used

pre_assigned_instructor.title: Pre-assigned instructor
pre_assigned_instructor.description: Class already had an instructor filled in, so that instructor assignment was preserved

registered_class_not_found.title: Registered class not found
registered_class_not_found.description: Swimmer's registered class name was not found in the selected classes file, so no class roster could be built for that swimmer

registered_class_full.title: Registered class full
registered_class_full.description: Swimmer's registered class matched the selected classes file, but the current fixed-roster workflow only supports two swimmers per class row so the swimmer could not be placed into that class

pre_assigned_instructor_name_ambiguous.title: Pre-assigned instructor name ambiguous
pre_assigned_instructor_name_ambiguous.description: A pre-assigned instructor name matched more than one instructor record, so one was chosen automatically and should be verified

adapted_swimmer_single_legal_instructor.title: Single adapted-capable option
adapted_swimmer_single_legal_instructor.description: Adapted swimmer has only one legal adapted-capable instructor available — no flexibility in assignment

below_min_auto_assign_score.title: Below auto-assignment threshold
below_min_auto_assign_score.description: Best legal match is below the minimum auto-assign compatibility threshold

review_actions.verify_instructor_qualification_record: Verify that the instructor's qualification record is current and accurate
review_actions.confirm_policy_override: Confirm this policy override is intentional and appropriate
review_actions.review_continuity_tiebreak: Review why continuity was not preserved and confirm the tiebreak decision
review_actions.review_pairing_decision: Review the pairing decision and confirm the instructor assignment is acceptable
review_actions.review_pair_balance: Review whether one swimmer in the pair is significantly worse matched than the other
review_actions.update_swimmer_type: Update the swimmer's type based on survey or intake information
review_actions.update_instructor_profile: Update the instructor's color, style, and certification profile information
review_actions.consider_reassignment: Consider whether a better instructor assignment exists
review_actions.quick_review_assignment: Briefly review this assignment — it is not necessarily bad but should be checked
review_actions.confirm_no_better_option_available: Confirm that no better instructor option was available given the constraints
review_actions.verify_note_request_still_applies: Verify that the note request that influenced this assignment is still current
review_actions.review_manual_assignment_override: Review whether a below-threshold legal match should be manually assigned
review_actions.verify_class_registration: Verify that the swimmer's registered class name matches an active class in the selected classes file
